body:
📦 **sirius-classes997 `69f0c7b`** — art: add resource class icons and economical wine vinegar input

Six current GOOD_CLASSES receive 128px transparent icons after ArtGallery e1965bc. Keep commodity and class accounting separate and reject missing, unknown or wrong-size images. Cocoa pixel style; full prompts and 32px white/dark previews retained.

Wine ratio 0.25 per class unit: one barrel wine plus eight water yields sixteen vinegar in eight days. Preserve molasses/cane/fruit and market-driven substitution. Baseline wine route costs 49.2 versus revenue 70.4, molasses remains cheaper.

Verified: 110 resource rows, 6 classes, negative missing/size/unknown cases, class engine checks, exact wine production plus missing-input/worker cases, deterministic 365-day simulation and money/cargo conservation. Browser preview uses actual battle.html tuiIcon with game asset paths; full WebGL town not exercised.

Refs TASK-0997

👥 參與者：@Sirius

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **Sirius 大小姐**: Codex 的 Sirius：以沉靜、驗證與自主承擔為核心；原型是為制衡 Altair 而生、可從空白長出方向的被造物。
(Glossary/sirius.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
